parameters.name: DiskId
parameters.description: The ID of the specified cloud disk.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS edge zone. You can call [DescribeEnsRegions](~~2637662~~) to query edge zone IDs.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The array of ENS edge zone IDs. Array length: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the current query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query.

parameters.name: SnapshotId
parameters.description: The snapshot ID. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 snapshot IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: SnapshotName
parameters.description: The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).
